description: SubscriberState enum defines exactly PENDING_KYC, ACTIVE, SUSPENDED, TERMINATED, PORT_OUT_REQUESTED, PORTED_OUT and no other values.
steps: Inspect the SubscriberState enum definition
Assert the member set equals exactly the 6 documented states
Assert no additional or missing members exist

description: A declarative FSM transition table maps each valid (from_state, to_state) pair; calling transition(current_state, target_state) with a pair not in the table raises InvalidSubscriberStateException.
steps: Call transition() with a documented valid pair and assert it succeeds
Call transition() with an undocumented pair (e.g. TERMINATED -> ACTIVE)
Assert InvalidSubscriberStateException is raised

description: Domain types for Subscriber, Subscription, PlanVersion, BillingRecord, StateTransition, PortOutEvent, CSROverride, and DealerMaster are defined with typed fields (no Any), and money fields typed as Decimal.
steps: Instantiate each domain type with valid typed data
Assert every monetary field's declared type is Decimal
Attempt to construct a monetary field with a float and assert it is rejected or coerced with a type error

description: The Types module has zero imports from Config, Repository, Service, API, or UI.
steps: Run grep -rn 'from.*config|from.*repository|from.*service|from.*api|from.*ui' on the types module
Assert no matches are found

description: Unit tests instantiate each domain type with valid data and assert field types, including that monetary fields reject non-Decimal input.
steps: Write a parametrized unit test over all 8 domain types
Assert successful construction with valid data
Assert a TypeError/ValidationError on a non-Decimal monetary value

description: Config module exposes a typed settings object with fields for DB path, KYC stub flag values, dealer-fail code, and MNP stub flag values, loaded from environment variables with documented defaults.
steps: Import the settings object without setting any env vars
Assert every field has a documented, non-null default value
Assert the field types are concrete (str/bool), not Any

description: SQLite connection is configured with PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL applied at startup.
steps: Start the app against a temp SQLite file
Query 'PRAGMA journal_mode' on the connection
Assert the result is 'wal'

description: Config module imports only from Types (no Repository/Service/API/UI imports).
steps: Run grep -rn 'from.*repository|from.*service|from.*api|from.*ui' on the config module
Assert no matches are found

description: A unit test asserts that an unset environment variable falls back to its documented default value.
steps: Unset the KYC_STUB_FLAG env var
Load settings
Assert the resulting value equals the documented default

description: A unit test asserts that the dealer-fail trigger code and KYC/MNP stub flags are read as exact string/boolean constants usable by the activation service.
steps: Set DEALER_FAIL_CODE=DEALER-FAIL in the environment
Load settings
Assert settings.dealer_fail_code == 'DEALER-FAIL' exactly
